summary: The marketing team is driving search visibility for the Asia Star and Intelligent China programs while finalizing the Knowledge website redesign and resolving a persistent Outlook lockout that has stalled email access across devices.
summaryDetail: The top priority this week is resolving the Outlook account lockout—stale credentials on multiple devices are blocking email access, and the team must update passwords on all laptops and phones, re-login, and confirm the backend unlock with JSB. In parallel, the search visibility initiative for Asia Star and Intelligent China is gaining momentum: Joseph is drafting the target search areas and prompts, the team is analyzing participant profiles and CRM leads, and conversion tracking setup needs a brief to guide optimization. The Knowledge website redesign is nearing completion, with the decision to keep the current design, adjust menu categorization, and disperse videos by topic; a 30-minute working session is needed to mark specific feedback before Joker revises the design. Looking ahead, preparation for the APEC event concept note and the 2026 Women in Leadership Forum design proposal require attention, while the CKGSB Monthly header has been approved and the Collaboration Award application has been submitted.
